text: DRUG INTERACTIONS CONCOMITANT ADMINISTRATION OF VANCOMYCIN AND ANESTHETIC AGENTS HAS BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH ERYTHEMA AND HISTAMINE-LIKE FLUSHING (SEE PEDIATRIC USE, PRECAUTIONS ) AND ANAPHYLACTOID REACTIONS (SEE ADVERSE REACTIONS ). MONITOR RENAL FUNCTION IN PATIENTS RECEIVING VANCOMYCIN AND CONCURRENT AND/OR SEQUENTIAL SYSTEMIC OR TOPICAL USE OF OTHER POTENTIALLY, NEUROTOXIC AND/OR NEPHROTOXIC DRUGS, SUCH AS AMPHOTERICIN B, AMINOGLYCOSIDES, BACITRACIN, POLYMYXIN B, COLISTIN, VIOMYCIN, OR CISPLATIN. CONTRAINDICATIONS VANCOMYCIN HYDROCHLORIDE FOR INJECTION IS CONTRAINDICATED IN PATIENTS WITH KNOWN HYPERSENSITIVITY TO THIS ANTIBIOTIC.
